scope: isolated pure reference datum core and versioned contract; no existing kernels, runtime, IPC, UI, version, release or main-workspace changes

checks.oracle: stdlib Fraction and mpmath==1.3.0 at 120 decimal digits

checks.command: Original independent-review portable replay.sh in a fresh temporary directory

limitations: Reference datum definition only; no physical stability or significance inference
No verified immutable record binding; caller source pointers and covariance/dependence declarations remain unverified
No automatic interpretation of existing free-leveling cofactors as absolute covariance
Near-zero joint correlation spectrum is explicitly semidefinite-or-numerically-unresolved, not a certified PSD result; no matrix repair
GLS singular or ill-conditioned reference covariance returns unavailable without switching method
Negative propagated variances are refused, never clipped
Roundoff diagnostics are software estimates, not certified numerical or engineering accuracy bounds
